package: OnTime v5 complete all-in-one bundle — LightGBM startup fix
source_data: Nine original Olist CSV files; raw hashes are listed below and in data/processed/raw_manifest.json.

model.name: Dispatch operational XGBoost model
model.scope: Simulated operational signals and labels; not measured real-world delivery performance.

verification.leakage_audit: PASS; 70 features at four cut dates
verification.tests: 211 passed, 2 legacy XGBoost/pickle compatibility warnings; includes regression coverage for a TypeError during optional LightGBM/Dask import.
verification.live_weather: Open-Meteo API route and mocked tests pass; live provider request from this build environment failed with URLError, so live external connectivity remains unverified.
verification.synthetic_dataset: 80,000 rows; 38 columns; 0 duplicate synthetic order IDs; binary target; saved model reloaded and held-out chronological ROC-AUC reproduced at 0.9432527722262533 and PR-AUC 0.8927009431674501; target threshold >0.91 passed for synthetic benchmark only.
verification.production_model_integration: PASS; portable dispatch XGBoost JSON is loaded and wired to live single-order and batch scoring. Settings, /api/meta, /api/model, /api/models, the Model page and assistant share the effective live model key.
verification.frontend_backend_sync: PASS; frontend syntax check, Python compilation, and live-scoring metadata contract tests pass; model page/API expose the configured model without legacy checkout evaluation metrics.
verification.deployment_smoke: PASS; running local HTTP server passed 11 checks covering frontend, readiness, model metadata, summary, risk queue, single-order inference, batch template, and batch inference.
verification.operational_validation: PASS for tooling/tests only; a chronological observed-outcome validation CLI now requires timestamped predictions and a separate observed outcomes file. No real-world validation report exists because no actual operational outcomes file is configured.
verification.lightgbm_startup_fix: PASS; app runtime does not require LightGBM, import failure is caught, and a regression test verifies engine startup under simulated Dask/pandas descriptor TypeError.

security: Local .env, database/settings, virtual environments and caches are excluded from the archive.

synthetic_benchmark.scope: Synthetic dispatch-time benchmark only; integrated into live dispatch scoring, but not real Olist or real-world production performance.

production_live_scoring.historical_queue_model: Separate historical order queue based on stored historical features
production_live_scoring.scope_note: Dispatch features and labels are simulated. Scores are labelled SYNTHETIC_BENCHMARK and are not calibrated real-world probabilities.
production_live_scoring.upgrade_migration: Existing saved auto defaults migrate to synthetic_operational; explicit xgboost/enriched choices are preserved.

live_scoring_sync.public_model_endpoint: Live scoring metadata only; historical checkout evaluation values are not mixed into the active model status payload.

verification.deployment_http_smoke: 11 checks passed against a running local server
